aesthetic_contract.emotional_thesis: Name the feeling and dramatic visual argument of the complete connected place; hero/primary_subject may identify its governing spatial composition rather than a giant prop.
aesthetic_contract.palette_value_opposition: Name the warm/cool and light/dark opposition; a palette list alone is insufficient.
aesthetic_contract.physical_medium: Name the physical or simulated medium.
mark_language: Name the distinct marks used by depth and importance.
aesthetic_contract.asymmetry_rhythm: Describe layout, rooms/activity clusters, recognizable objects, and selective accents; preserve circulation without a furniture or detail quota.
causal_relationships: Describe visible use and relationships; functional furniture groupings may use nonphysical controls/contains/marks edges while real architectural joints retain socket proof.
aesthetic_contract.state_transformation: State that one static fictional map is sufficient unless Ben explicitly requested variants; if requested, name only the actual requested visible change.

accepted_visual_anchors.role: Exact benchmark role appropriate to feature/setting/view scale; state inspection-only restrictions where applicable. Comparison approval does not admit pixels to production lineage.

composition.desaturated_read: Describe value/silhouette separation of rooms, openings, obstructions, elevations, and recognizable objects at practical VTT scale; atmosphere cannot conceal them.

assets.occlusion_profile: May pass beneath the threshold; its centerline and opening remain visible.
Piers cover only road margins; the opening remains legible.

joins.seam: Paving continues through the arch opening and terminates at both piers.
joins.occlusion: Piers occlude road margins; no base or shadow crosses the clear opening.

edges.visible_evidence: The opening spans the road threshold.

requirements.shall: The threshold assembly shall visibly mark the route without obstructing its opening.
requirements.verification: unprimed blockout and finished cold-authorship review
